purpose: Two-player co-located Light Cycle Classic Grid Duel on a shared physical tabletop, with deterministic lethal light walls and synchronized Rive match UI.
runtimeSurface: Viro mixed reality on supported co-located device families; same deterministic gameplay core rendered by Three.js for web/non-spatial play.

hero.role: Shared tabletop combat arena and primary gameplay read

circulation.description: Players remain physically outside the virtual board and may walk around the table. Never require reaching through or stepping into the arena volume.

artifacts.visualTarget: TRON-inspired black glass Grid with cyan/orange energy, without shipping proprietary film/game assets.
